name: maya-codex-bridge
description: Authenticated, constrained local MCP control for Autodesk Maya 2027 modeling, bind-pose diagnostics, UV, texture, and delivery workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect, model, diagnose skin, unwrap, and texture safely in Maya 2027.
interface.longDescription: A local, authenticated bridge between Codex and Maya 2027 for constrained scene inspection, polygon creation, bind-pose diagnostics and guarded repair, UV editing and snapshots, allowlisted file textures, materials, rig-aware assets, skinning, and FBX export. It exposes allowlisted Maya API operations and never sends mouse or keyboard events.
defaultPrompt: Check Maya status and inspect the selected asset without changing the scene.
Build a staged Maya model from the selected mesh and report each verified quality check.
Inspect UVs, assign a local texture, and export a safe UV snapshot.
Diagnose an FBX bind-pose warning and propose only a guarded, evidence-backed repair.
